text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski and Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski to sign Macedonia-European Union cooperation agreement in Luxembourg on Tuesday. Macedonia will receive 150 million ECU credit line.

- Macedonian corporation Elektrostopanstvo and Greek-Russian corporation East Power negotiate for acquisition of equipment for Kozjak hydroelectric power station. Possible favourable credit line worth $33.5 million.

- Owner of collapsed TAT pyramid savings scheme Sonja Nikolovska will address mass protest rally of depositors on Saturday at central square in Bitola. Nikolovska has threatened to reveal the names of influential people who in January withdrew 30 million German marks from her institution.

- Due to epidemic of brucelosis in the Tetovo village Germo, 82 heads of cattle destroyed in the last two days. Twenty people also infected, 15 of whom are still in the infectious diseases clinic in Tetovo. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
